title: Industrial Engineer Manager/ Head
description:
**WE ARE HIRING | INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING MANAGER / HEAD**

**Bhuvaneswari Tex | Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

Bhuvaneswari Tex is looking for an experienced
**Industrial Engineering Manager / Head**
in garment manufacturing to lead our IE function and drive productivity, efficiency, and continuous improvement across our garment manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead and manage the Industrial Engineering team.

• Conduct
**SMV, time studies, line balancing, capacity planning, and productivity analysis**
.

• Improve line efficiency, manpower utilization, and production output.

• Monitor production efficiency, targets, and key performance indicators.

• Work closely with Production, Planning, Quality, and Merchandising teams.

• Drive process improvements across
**cutting, sewing, finishing, and packing**
.

**Requirements:**

• 8+ years of relevant experience in
**Industrial Engineering within garment manufacturing**
.

• Proven experience in leading an IE team.

• Hands-on experience in a large-scale garment manufacturing setup will be preferred.

📍
**Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Interested candidates can share their CV with us email at**
info@b-tex.com
